title: ConnectAd S2S bidder params (Prebid Server)
description: A schema which validates params accepted by the ConnectAd Adapter

endpointUrl.description: Client-side only (Prebid.js): override the bid endpoint URL for testing or a custom datacenter. Prebid Server always uses its configured endpoint and does not route based on this value; if present it may still be forwarded inside imp.ext.bidder.
